title: EXPLORING FINE-TUNING FOR TABULAR FOUNDATION MODELS
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a subject of the analysis. The research focused on performance, calibration, and fairness of tabular foundation models on general and demographic tasks that did not include religious attributes.
